# mv: rename a type declaration (standalone, not in group)
mv T NewT
-- x.go --
package m

type T int

func F(x T) T { return x }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 package m

-type T int
+type NewT int

-func F(x T) T { return x }
+func F(x NewT) NewT { return x }
